en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, traditional wooden building with a gabled roof and three chimneys, set on a slightly sloping, grassy landscape with a few bushes and a circular garden bed. The style is simple and rural. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text identifying the place, beginning with the word "SCOUTH…". The postcard is bordered and appears to be laid on a textured surface.
